units.source_text: 出家为尼的外祖母，现已十分衰老。

en.t: Her maternal grandmother, who had taken vows as a nun, was now extremely old.

units.source_text: 她能够看见这个贵为女御的外孙女，似觉身在梦中，立刻走近去亲近她。

en.t: To be able to see this granddaughter, now honored as a lady-in-waiting, felt like a dream, and she at once drew near to be close to her.

units.source_text: 明石夫人多年来在宫中陪伴女御，却并未将明石时代的旧事详细告诉她。

en.t: Lady Akashi had attended the lady-in-waiting at court for many years, but she had never told her in detail about the old days at Akashi.

units.source_text: 但这老尼姑由于不堪其乐，一到女御身边，就淌着眼泪，用颤抖的声音把陈年旧事讲给她听。

en.t: But this old nun, unable to contain her joy, came to the lady-in-waiting's side and, with tears streaming down, told her the long-ago stories in a trembling voice.

units.source_text: 女御起初觉得此人奇怪，有些可厌，只管盯着她看。

en.t: At first the lady-in-waiting found this woman strange and somewhat unpleasant, and only stared at her.

units.source_text: 继而想起自己原有这样的一个外祖母，就姑且听她讲讲。

en.t: Then she remembered that she did indeed have such a maternal grandmother, and for the moment listened to what she had to say.

units.source_text: 后来终于很亲近她了。

en.t: In time, she finally became very close to her.

units.source_text: 老尼姑把女御诞生时的光景和源氏谪居明石浦时的情况讲给她听，

en.t: The old nun told her about the circumstances of the lady-in-waiting's birth and about Genji's exile at Akashi Bay,

units.source_text: 又说：“主君即将离明石浦返京都时，

en.t: and she added, "When our lord was about to leave Akashi Bay and return to the capital,

units.source_text: 我们大家都很惋惜悲伤，以为缘尽于此，今后不得再见了。

en.t: we were all filled with sorrow and regret, thinking that our bond had ended there and that we would never see him again.

units.source_text: 岂知贵女诞生，使我们都交了好运，这宿世因缘真可感谢啊！”

en.t: Who could have known that your birth would bring good fortune to us all? This bond from former lives is truly something to be grateful for!"

units.source_text: 说到这里，簌簌地流下泪来。

en.t: Having said this, she shed tears in a steady stream.

units.source_text: 明石女御想到：“这些旧事实在令人感动。

en.t: The Akashi lady-in-waiting thought, "These old stories are truly moving.

units.source_text: 要不是这位老外祖母说给我听，我永远不会知道自己的身世了。”

en.t: If this old grandmother had not told me, I would never have known the truth of my own origins."

units.source_text: 也啜泣起来。

en.t: She too began to sob.

units.source_text: 继而又想：“如此说来，像我这样身份的人，本来是不该公然身居高位的。

en.t: Then she thought further, "If that is so, someone of my birth should never have openly held such a high rank.

units.source_text: 全靠紫夫人教养和栽培，外人对我不敢十分轻视。

en.t: It is entirely thanks to Lady Murasaki's upbringing and care that others have not dared to look down on me too greatly.

units.source_text: 我一向自以为高贵无比，在宫中时目空一切，盛气凌人，恐怕世人都在背后咒骂我吧。”

en.t: I have always thought myself incomparably noble, and at court I looked down on everything and behaved arrogantly; surely people have been cursing me behind my back."

units.source_text: 此时她才明白了自己的身世。

en.t: Only then did she understand the truth of her own origins.

units.source_text: 她的生母身份稍稍低微，她原是知道的。

en.t: She had always known that her birth mother was of somewhat low status.

units.source_text: 但她自己诞生时的情况，和如此辽远的穷乡僻壤，她一向不知。

en.t: But she had never known the circumstances of her own birth, nor anything about such a distant, remote backwater.

units.source_text: 这大约是太娇养之故，但亦可谓太不懂事了。

en.t: This was probably because she had been raised with too much pampering, but it could also be called a great lack of worldly understanding.
